title: SPAM: Synthwave Photo App Promo
summary: A 15 s retro-synthwave promo for a photo app called SPAM, wrapped in a fake camcorder HUD (REC, timecode, chapter labels like '01 IGNITION / TRIM PATHS'). Neon app icon draws itself, smashes into full-bleed pixel-font word cards ('SHOOT.', 'REPEAT.'), flies through a 3D tunnel of photo tiles and an 80s wireframe sunset, then lands on a chrome logo lockup. Loud, nostalgic, toy-like.
fit_reason: Fun 80s-neon consumer aesthetic; reads as gaming/novelty, the opposite of a calm premium B2B portal.

palette.mood: neon synthwave, saturated purple/magenta with hot-pink and yellow flash cards

typography.display: chunky blocky pixel/bitmap font (8-bit), plus chrome-gradient italic wordmark and small mono HUD text
typography.size_behaviour: huge full-bleed single word on flat colour cards; small mono HUD labels in corners
typography.notes: Word cards end with a square full stop ('SHOOT.', 'REPEAT.'). Wordmark 'SPAM' has cyan-to-pink chrome stripes and RGB-split offset.

text_animation: pixel-font word stamps in with glitch/scanline slices
RGB chromatic split on reveal ('NO LIMITS' grows out of the horizon with sparkle)
scale-in of 3D chrome text along the grid floor
tagline pill types/pops under the logo
motion: trim-path stroke draw of the rounded-square icon
stacked offset outlines (orange/pink/cyan) echoing behind the icon
horizontal speed-line whoosh pushes icon off frame
parallax flyover of wireframe mountains and grid
transitions: hard cut on beat to flat colour word card
graphic_elements: camcorder HUD frame (REC dot, timecode, frame counter, chapter label)
photo tile grid with x16 counter
ui_treatment: Stylised phone mockup with Instagram-like feed in neon; floating '48 NEW PHOTOS' pill toast.

sound.sync: cuts and word cards on the beat

signature_moves: fake camcorder HUD overlay with chapter labels naming the animation technique
neon trim-path icon with triple offset echoes
full-bleed pixel-font single-word cards on hot pink / yellow
80s wireframe sunset flyover with chrome type rising from the grid

best_segments.what: Icon trim-path draw, echo outlines, speed-line whoosh into SHOOT./REPEAT. pixel cards

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP or Remotion: SVG stroke-dashoffset for trim paths, CSS 3D transforms for tunnel and grid, pixel font (Press Start 2P / Silkscreen), scanline + RGB-split filters, HUD overlay as static SVG.
recreate.prompt: 80s synthwave product promo inside a camcorder REC HUD: neon rounded-square app icon draws itself with cyan/pink/orange echo outlines, smash cuts to full-bleed hot-pink and yellow cards with one huge pixel-font word, fly over a wireframe grid toward a striped orange sun, chrome logo lockup.
